import type { ReactNode, Ref, ComponentType } from "react";
import type { Input, Output } from "./contracts";
export type { Input };

export type AttributeName = `data-${string}` | `aria-${string}`;
export type Label = "two  spaces" | "<div>// literal content</div>";
export type Children = ReactNode | readonly ReactNode[];
export type PropsFor<Component> = Component extends ComponentType<infer Props> ? Props : never;

export interface ViewProps<Value extends Input> {
    /** Caller-owned data, including optional nested children. */
    readonly value: Value;
    children?: Children;
    ref?: Ref<HTMLElement>;
    style?: { color?: string; margin?: number | `${number}px` };
    onChange(value: Value, source: "keyboard" | "pointer"): void;
    renderItem?: (item: Value, index: number) => ReactNode;
    [name: `data-${string}`]: unknown;
}

export interface ProviderProps {
    children: ReactNode;
    context: { readonly request: Input; dispatch(request: Input): Promise<Output> };
}

export declare function View<Value extends Input>(properties: ViewProps<Value>, forwarded_reference: Ref<HTMLElement>): ReactNode;
export declare function Provider(properties: ProviderProps): ReactNode;
export const Component = <Value extends Input,>(properties: ViewProps<Value>, forwarded_reference: Ref<HTMLElement>): ReactNode =>;
export const Panel = (properties: ProviderProps, children: readonly ReactNode[]): ReactNode =>;
export const Legacy = function(properties: ProviderProps);

export abstract class ViewController<Value extends Input> {
    protected current: Value;
    readonly ref: Ref<HTMLElement>;
    constructor(initial_value: Value, forwarded_reference: Ref<HTMLElement>);
    abstract render(properties: ViewProps<Value>, render_callback: (value: Value, index: number) => ReactNode): ReactNode;
    update(value: Value): void;
    get active(): boolean;
}

export namespace Components {
    export interface ButtonProps {
        label: string;
        disabled?: boolean;
        onClick(event: MouseEvent): void;
    }
    export function Button(properties: ButtonProps): ReactNode;
    export type Wrapped<Props> = Props & { children?: ReactNode; key?: string | number };
}

/**
 * JSX implementation bodies are excluded from declaration overviews. Their component signatures, generic parameters, callbacks, and literal prop types remain.
 * <View label="// not a code comment" /> is documentation text.
 */
export function Documented(properties: ViewProps<Input>, response_callback: (value: Output, source: "ui") => void): ReactNode;
